subject: Post-signature orchestration: MAP, canary window & training alignment
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@lynchpinclinic.com>, Rajiv Sinha <rajiv.sinha@lynchpinclinic.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature orchestration: MAP, canary window & training alignment

Hi Emily and Rajiv,

Congrats again on signing — excited to get Lynchpin Clinic onto Redwood. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation milestones we discussed: rollout phases, canary cohort, migration runbook, and training cadence. Key asks from our side to make sure dates are realistic:

- Confirm the preferred canary cohort (3–5 clinics vs single site) and acceptable traffic split window (recommended 10–25% for 2 weeks).
- Confirm data migration blackout windows for your EHR vendor (if any).
- Who on your side will own acceptance testing (UAT sign-off)? Name(s) + email preferred so we can add them to the MAP.

Proposed immediate next steps (this week):
1) Short call with Marcus (solutions) + your Ops lead to finalize canary scope (30–45 min).
2) We publish an updated MAP with exact dates and training slots.
3) Delivery of migration runbook draft for your review.

Attachments: lynchpin_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP), migration_runbook_draft.pdf (draft runbook), training_agenda_v2.docx (draft).

I can do a call on Monday 5/24 morning PST or Tuesday afternoon PST — what works for you both?

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Rajiv Sinha <rajiv.sinha@lynchpinclinic.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Emily Hart <emily.hart@lynchpinclinic.com>
Cc: procurement@lynchpinclinic.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature orchestration: MAP, canary window & training alignment

Sofia — thanks and congrats team. Quick responses inline: 

- Canary cohort: prefer single pilot site (our downtown clinic) first, then expand to 3–4 sites in phase 2.
- Migration blackout: our EHR vendor typically requires a maintenance window 2AM–4AM local time on Sundays. We prefer non-business-hour migrations.
- UAT owner: Emily (cc'd) will own functional acceptance; I'll put procurement on any contract/ops checklist items.

Monday 5/24 morning PST works for us (9–10am PST is ideal). Please send calendar invite.

— Rajiv
Rajiv Sinha
Director of Digital Ops, Lynchpin Clinic
rajiv.sinha@lynchpinclinic.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@lynchpinclinic.com>, Rajiv Sinha <rajiv.sinha@lynchpinclinic.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature orchestration: MAP, canary window & training alignment

Thanks Rajiv — perfect. Looping in Marcus (solutions eng) and Monica (CS) so we can cover migration and training specifics on Monday's call.

I updated the MAP (v1) with two alternate canary tracks: single-site pilot (A) and multi-site pilot (B). High-level summary embedded below:

MAP excerpt (high level):
- Phase 0 (Week 0–1): Prep & security onboarding — KMS/HSM details, SOC 2 artifacts exchanged, network allowlists configured.
- Phase 1 (Week 2–3): Data migration dry-run — non-prod snapshot and reconciliation.
- Phase 2 (Week 4–5): Canary pilot (downtown clinic, 10–20% traffic) — monitor latency, error rates, and quality regressions.
- Phase 3 (Week 6–8): Staged rollout to cohort sites + full training cadence.

Training plan (draft):
- Weekday live sessions (2 x 60 min) for ops and clinicians (recorded).
- Hands-on sandbox exercises with sample patient flows.
- Acceptance sign-off checklist (UAT owner: Emily).

Marcus — can you bring the migration play checklist and proposed monitoring thresholds to the call? Monica — please propose two training slots on Tue/Wed next week for clinician sessions.

Drive links and HubSpot record included in the MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cLYNCHPIN-MAP, HubSpot: HS-14287.

I'll send a calendar invite for Mon 5/24 9am PST now.

Best,
Sofia
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Emily Hart <emily.hart@lynchpinclinic.com>
Cc: Rajiv Sinha <rajiv.sinha@lynchpinclinic.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature orchestration: MAP, canary window & training alignment

Thanks — agenda noted. Quick notes from CS perspective:

- Canary cohort selection: single-site pilot is lower risk. For monitoring, recommend the following thresholds to trigger rollback or pause:
  - Latency p95 increase > 150ms above baseline for 3 consecutive hours
  - Error rate > 1% sustained for 30 minutes
  - First 48-hour spike in false-positive/quality regressions > 5% on a validation set

- Training slots: Tue 5/25 10:00am PST (Ops + Clinicians) and Wed 5/26 2:00pm PST (Clinician deep dive). We'll record both.

- Migration runbook: Marcus and I will attach a short runbook checklist to the MAP before the call.

See you Monday 9am PST.

--
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Emily Hart <emily.hart@lynchpinclinic.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Sinha <rajiv.sinha@lynchpinclinic.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature orchestration: MAP, canary window & training alignment

Thanks all — appreciate the clarity. Confirming:

- Emily will be UAT owner and available for the Tue/Wed training windows; prefer Tue 10am first.
- Downtown clinic as single-site pilot is acceptable.
- One ask: please include a short rollback play that covers data re-sync and customer notification cadence (we prefer rollback within 2 hours of breach conditions).

Forwarding Monica's thresholds into our internal ops channel for awareness. Looking forward to Monday's call.
